name: Email Templates
description: Transactional email copy. Each entry fills the shared layout (server/utils/email-layout.ts): heading, lead, facts, quote, button, notes. Values are escaped at render time; no HTML.

about.description: What the email is about, for the footer ("This email is about …"); plain text

cta_url.description: Button URL, a single {param} that holds an absolute URL

facts.description: Optional key/value rows, one per line as "Label|value" — values support {param}, **bold**, `code`

name.description: Human-readable template name for admin reference

notes.description: Secondary paragraphs below the rule, separated by a blank line — same markup as lead

preheader.description: Hidden inbox preview text — supports {param} interpolation

quote.description: Optional quoted user text, usually a single {param}; rendered as plain escaped text

reply.description: Paragraph that invites a reply, added after the notes only when NUXT_EMAIL_REPLY_TO is set — same markup as lead

slug.description: Template identifier used in code (e.g. invite-added)

subject.description: Email subject line — supports {param} interpolation (plain text)
